stated_question: Will a dual-use imaging payload spread beyond its first buyers?

scqa.situation: A payload built for one sector attracts interest elsewhere.
scqa.complication: Capacity to absorb it differs by sector.
scqa.question: Who adopts first and what limits the next adopter?

goal.target: Estimate who follows the first buyers and when.
goal.falsifier: evidence that the zone is already covered

leaves.question: Will a dual-use imaging payload spread beyond its first buyers?

falsifier.text: Evidence that adoption stayed inside the first sector.

leaves.question: Which sectors show documented first purchases of comparable payloads?

falsifier.text: Records showing no cross-sector first purchases.

leaves.question: What technical staffing does a new sector need before it can integrate the payload?

falsifier.text: Cases where sectors integrated it with no added staffing.

leaves.question: How have earlier dual-use sensors crossed between civil and defense buyers?

falsifier.text: Cases where crossing was blocked by policy.

leaves.question: Where do the incumbent and the challenger sit on their adoption curves?

falsifier.text: Rate data placing both technologies at the same stage.
